take: Per the Penguins' announcement, Pittsburgh reassigned F Avery Hayes and D Chase Pietilla to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (AHL), placed F Elmer Soderblom on injured reserve, and activated F Justin Brazeau from injured reserve, assigning him to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton as well. Soderblom has played six games this season, 11.4 minutes a night, with no goals and one assist. Our numbers show him on the ice for 76% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five-on-five, though he hasn't scored. Hayes played one game, with no points. PIT sits at 5-6-1.
